title: Infernux v0.3.7 · Plugins and Skeletal Animation
summary: 0.3.7 adds the InxPackage plugin system, moves MCP out of the engine core, and fixes skeletal animation imported from separate FBX files.

items.title: Install from a .inxpkg, a local folder, Git, or the official list.

items.title: Runtime/ ships with the game. Editor/ stays in the Editor.

items.title: MCP moved to the default official plugin infernux/mcp. New projects include it. You can disable or uninstall it.

items.title: Retarget animation-only FBX files through exact joint identities while accepting Assimp-generated pivot and helper nodes between mapped joints.
